svg.aria-label: Dive log for the last 365 days: 475 metres down at one metre per contribution, the twilight zone. 36 active days, longest streak 12 days, longest break 78 days, 2 followers, 0 stars, 1 years on GitHub. Languages: TypeScript 73%, JavaScript 14%, Kotlin 5%, CSS 4%, HTML 2%.
